description: Candidate 8, part two. Elixir mode re-parses the shape of three body forms the compiler already parses: parse_for (elixir_mode.ex L1076-1084 vs compiler.ex L4058-4104), case_clause_head (L853-854 vs L5522-5535), the Enum.reduce_while / all? / any? argument patterns (L395-445 vs L1805-1850). About 40 lines, but a new for option or clause shape must be matched in two files. Decided: widen Defk.EnumForms (63 lines, already a pre-both-modes rewrite) and rename it Defk.Forms: the shape of a body form before either mode reads it, returning {quals, reduce, body} / {pat, guard, body, meta} / the Enum form's parts, with rejections through a callback the way Defk.Raise.parse!/2 works. ADR-0008 boundary: shared parsing of shape only; what a form means stays written twice. Tests: a forms_test over ASTs; the existing enum_forms coverage moves with the rename. Update docs/agents/compiler-map.md. Gate: mix dump_c byte-identical.

comments.text: PR #56 opened: https://github.com/DanielLuning/defk/pull/56. Defk.EnumForms -> Defk.Forms: for/3, case_clause/2, reduce_while/1, predicate/1 parse the shapes once; rejections through a callback (compiler &reject!/4, Elixir mode raise_form!/4); codes validated at compile time. test/forms_test.exs (15 tests). dump_c byte-identical for all 108 modules; mix ci green: 2285 passed.

title: Defk.Forms: body-form shapes parsed once for both modes
